text:
nina: Auditor Sam asked for a compact evidence package proving CVE-2027-4500 was triaged and the RBAC patch deployed, including KMS encrypt/decrypt records and deploy provenance. Sampling ok if chain of custody is clear.
henry: I have the ticket (INFSEC-1144), PR (https://github.com/redwood/security/pull/7040) and deploy tag release-2027.05.04. Deployed 2027-05-04T18:33Z. What format do they want for mapping?
auditor_sam: Prefer a control crosswalk CSV + one short PDF per control area (SOC2 and ISO refs). Need trace: vuln report -> ticket -> PR -> CI artifact hash + signature -> deploy pipeline run -> audit logs (k8s/cloud) -> KMS activity. Redaction/pseudonymization acceptable with documented transform.
jiayi: Plan: produce manifest.txt, control-crosswalk.csv, pr-ci-proof.pdf, logs-redacted.tar.gz, kms-pseudonymized.csv, attestation-signed.pdf. We'll sign the bundle and timestamp it.
henry: K8s slice I pulled with gcloud logging (example):
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.resourceName: "authz-service" AND timestamp>"2027-05-02T00:00:00Z"' --limit 2000 --format json > /tmp/k8s-audit.json
```
That returned ~3.4k entries for the window; will trim to deploy window.
jiayi: Cloud provider audit example (AWS CloudTrail):
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=PutRolePolicy --start-time 2027-05-03T00:00:00Z --end-time 2027-05-05T00:00:00Z --max-results 100 > /tmp/cloudtrail.json
```
I can extract principal identifiers and method names and pseudonymize.
auditor_sam: For pseudonymization we need algorithm + salt storage and an attestation that originals are retained securely. Also include CI artifact signature (cosign) and Rekor entry or TSA proof for the bundle.
jiayi: Pseudonymization snippet (HMAC-SHA512 example):
```
import hmac, hashlib
BUNDLE_SALT = b"evidence-1866667777-salt"
def hmac512(val):
    return hmac.new(BUNDLE_SALT, val.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha512).hexdigest()
# apply to principalEmail and ip fields, keep original->hmac mapping in internal-keystore
```
We'll store BUNDLE_SALT at internal-keystore/evidence/1866667777 and not include mapping in the export.
secinfra: Approved. HMAC-SHA512 is fine. Keep original->HMAC mapping in vault path internal-keystore/evidence/1866667777/mapping (access: compliance+legal NDA). Document algorithm and vault path in manifest. Do NOT include mapping in bundle.
henry: CI artifact: artifact-registry://redwood/builds/7040@sha256:ab12cd34.. We cosign it; Rekor URL: https://rekor.sigstore.dev/entries/xyz789. We'll attach cosign verify output and Rekor entry. Also include the pipeline run URL and a redacted screenshot of the deploy job.
jiayi: Redaction example (jq+sponge):
```
jq '(.entries[] | .principalEmail) |= "HMAC_REDACTED"' /tmp/k8s-audit.json > k8s-audit-redacted.json
```
Then post-process to replace HMAC_REDACTED with computed hmac512 values using mapping script.
auditor_sam: Good. Please include a signed attestation stating originals are available under NDA and the process to request. Also list retention period for originals.
secinfra: Originals retained per retention policy: 3 years for audit artifacts. Manifest will include internal artifact IDs and retention notes.
henry: evidence-bot: start assembling bundle: evidence-1866667777.zip (manifest + 6 artifacts).
evidence-bot: packaging job started: evidence-1866667777.zip (assembling 6 artifacts). ETA ~90s.
jiayi: One blocker: legal sign-off on attestation text. I'll ping legal; should be quick.
auditor_sam: Fine to proceed; I can review attestation language post-upload. Might request a single unredacted sample line (one k8s event + matching KMS record) under NDA for forensic validation.
secinfra: Added KMS attestation: keys are HSM-backed, rotation event recorded 2027-04-30T00:00Z, key version IDs included in attestation.
henry: Upload complete: gs://redwood-evidence/evidence-1866667777/evidence-1866667777.zip (4.4MB). sha256: 9f1a2b3c... Manifest includes cosign + Rekor URLs and bundle timestamp (RFC3161 TSA).
jiayi: PR to compliance mapping repo: https://github.com/redwood/compliance/pull/245 contains control crosswalk linking filenames to SOC2/ISO controls.
auditor_sam: I'll validate and ACK or request NDA-sample. Thanks everyone.
secinfra: Closing loop: ticket INFSEC-1144-EVID updated with links and short instructions for NDA request.
